profile.overview: Golgari Swarm is a black-green guild associated with Ravnica.
profile.philosophy: Death, decay, survival, and renewal are one cycle, not separate moral categories.
profile.core_tension: Golgari is philosophically stable around cycles, but politically unstable because succession, overthrow, and reanimation are built into the system.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide presents Golgari as an underground society in forgotten places that also feeds much of Ravnica.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Undergrowth expresses Golgari's ability to turn dead creatures in graveyards into present power.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: This is a compact first-pass JSON package generated from official overview and mechanics sources.
